node.title: Re: Perl detect utf8, iso-8859-1 encoding
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: If you're just trying to tell the difference between those two encodings, then note that a lot of text encoded with Latin1 is not valid UTF-8, so simply attempting to decode it as UTF-8 will already give you a very good hint. I demonstrated this with some code (plus heuristics) in [id://11117198|this node].
